title: Snapchat Recap 2026 Is Coming. Sign Up for a Special Surprise!
summary: Your official 2026 Snap Recap is coming soon and we want to celebrate by mailing you a surprise gift!
body_markdown:
2026 is almost over, which can only mean one thing… **Snapchat Recap 2026 is right around the corner!**


From the everyday Snaps to the moments that made you laugh, 2026 was full of memories worth looking back on, especially the ones shared with your Best Friend.


To celebrate, we're giving a few lucky Snapchatters a little something special to celebrate the friendship that made your year one to remember.


**Want in? Sign up \[**[HERE](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScrQ9eroE-CxqqYfrbL0F7Gh8XfgN_wcwpdOOorVBG8f_hTVg/viewform) **\] by November 18** for a chance to receive a special Snapchat surprise!


We can't wait for you to look back at your year when Snapchat Recap 2026 arrives next month!


*Terms & Conditions: First come, first serve while supplies last. You must be 18+, have a Bitmoji. US only. Entries close November 18, 2026.*
